close_reason: Moved valid_until into CachedStsEntry; cache is now HashMap<String, CachedStsEntry>
description: The cache is HashMap<String, (CachedStsEntry, Instant)> where the outer Instant is valid_until. But CachedStsEntry already contains last_id_check: Instant, so there are two Instants: one inside the struct and one in the tuple. At usage sites the code destructures as (entry, valid_until) or (entry, _), making it easy to mistake which Instant is which. Both Instants belong to the same logical entry; moving valid_until into CachedStsEntry (alongside last_id_check) removes the ambiguity and flattens the HashMap type to HashMap<String, CachedStsEntry>.
title: MtaStsEnforcer cache: valid_until lives outside CachedStsEntry as tuple element
